answer: Audits are entered in relic, queued in lantern, and timber publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 60 identities per epoch. A farm of 258 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2578 identities would post 2702 proofs and burn roughly 52 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
